t: An open hardware Linux board with many radios and plug-in sensor ports.
steps: Buy the board from SparkFun for about 99 US dollars, or from DigiKey or Mouser.
Get a 5 volt USB-C power supply and a coin cell for the clock.
Follow the BeaglePlay quick start guide on the BeagleBoard docs site.
Connect a screen, a keyboard and then power.
Log in to Debian and open a terminal.
Plug a Grove or Qwiic sensor into a port.
Run a short Python example to print the sensor readings.
meta: Open Board. From $99. A few stores.
